Name: Kenneth's Spacious Farm - Balanced
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]My vanilla farm felt too small, so I made it twice as big but still balanced.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]104x100 = 10,400 tiles. Exactly double vanilla (80x65 = 5,200). Not too wide, not too tall, just square-ish so it's easy to plan. My favorite for chill playthroughs.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All tiles tillable. Plant anywhere.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Two versions inside:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Standard: For old saves, overwrites Standard Farm.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Additional Farms: For new games, appears in farm type picker + day 1 mail gives back lost furniture (old bug fixed).[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Needs SMAPI + Content Patcher. 1.6.[/b][/size]
